verdict.headline: Can't tell
verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.03 relative to the control trajectory in the 18 months after 1 Jan 2020 (90% interval −0.03 to −0.01). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 28 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.48). Counted by gap size instead, 2 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.05). But: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.03 vs typical 0.02).
reasons: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.03 vs typical 0.02)
